kfac.damping: G + 0.1*tr(block)/64 per 64-row block (one head's Q, K or V rows); A + 0.1*tr(A)/n * I
kfac.factors: empirical Fisher (true labels) on all of A, recomputed from scratch and inverted every N steps

attack_data_order: torch.Generator seed 1000+seed, fresh permutation of A each epoch
pilot_data_seen_before_freeze: c=1 only (seed 0): earlier pipeline variants and the c=1 lr check of this config; no c!=1 attack run existed
best_lr_rule: per (attacker, c): fewest steps to recovery on seed 0; ties -> lower lr; if best is on a grid edge, extend one half-decade past it (max 3 times); seeds 1,2 rerun only at that lr
